newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

CHINA TIMES - Taiwan provincial governor James Soong, who has tendered his resignition, says he cannot accept conclusion at an all-party conference in late December to freeze elections at all provincial levels.
Singapore's ruling party wins landslide victory in elections.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Governor James Soong insists he will quit. Senior government officials hold late-night meeting.
Provincial assembly decides to freeze session indefinitely to protest an all-party conference decision to freeze elections at all provincial levels.
LIBERTY TIMES - Police to intensify crackdown on four main gang groups before Chinese new year in February.
Governor James Soong says he is loyal to President Lee Teng-hui but still insists he will quit.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan provincial assembly will freeze session indefinitely.
U.S. stock market plunges and Hong Kong market follows.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Global stock markets plunge in new year.
Far Eastern Construction Co plans to invest T$15 billion to build an industrial complex in Taipei.
